//: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL is baked into the bundle AT BUILD TIME, so it cannot
be changed on the device afterwards. That is why each profile names its
own: a build pointed at 127.0.0.1 works only in a simulator sharing the
host's loopback, and on a real phone it fails with a network error that
looks like the server is down.
An empty value is not 'no server' by accident — it is the deliberate
demo mode in src/api/index.ts, which runs the app on fixtures and marks
every screen with a Demo chip so a demo is never mistaken for live data.

demo.//: Fixtures only. Nothing to configure, nothing to connect to, works on a plane.

//: A dev client against a server on this machine. Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
to the LAN address of the host, not localhost — the phone's loopback
is the phone. `ipconfig` / `ifconfig` gives it, and the server must be
listening on 0.0.0.0 (it is) with that origin in CORS_ORIGINS.
An installable APK for putting the app in someone's hands. Points at
staging; a preview build must never carry a production URL, because a
tester tapping Confirm would post to a real ledger.
